meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会系统性地把项目里每一个源文件完整读一遍,文件再多也不跳过;遇到大文件时,用 Read 工具的 offset 和 limit 参数分块翻页读完。
howto.when: 在开始一个新项目或不熟悉的项目时触发,或当你提到“learn the codebase”、“prime”、“get up to speed”等说法时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目的源码都读一遍,再开始改
say.note: Claude 会逐文件完整读取

say.text: 先 prime 一下这个代码库,我要加新功能
say.note: 读完全部源文件后再动手

say.text: 这个项目我不熟,帮我 learn the codebase
say.note: 它会从每个源文件读起

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude systematically reads every source file in the project in full, skipping none. Large files are paged through in chunks using the Read tool's offset and limit parameters.
howto.when_en: Triggers when starting a new or unfamiliar project, or when you say things like "learn the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

say_en.text: Read every source file in this project before we change anything
say_en.note: Claude reads each file in full

say_en.text: Prime this codebase first — I want to add a feature
say_en.note: It reads all sources, then starts

say_en.text: I'm unfamiliar with this repo, learn the codebase for me
